items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And we went into Cafe Society, and that's when Fletcher had a stroke down there, and then I took the band over for the finish of the engagement. Dick Vance was playing trumpet and me on clarinet and Lucky Thompson on tenor and Fletcher and Jimmy Crawford on drums

ctx.x: -- Herschel Evans came out of Hawkins too, didn't he?

That's right, Herschel Evans, Don -- Lucky Thompson, Don Byas, Ben Webster, Lockjaw Davis. All of those were -- Hawk inspired players -- Ike Quebec. And then you turn around on the other hand and you'll find guys like Bud Johnson, Stan Getz, Zoot Simms and all of them were -- Zoot was half in between.
Well, he liked Ben too. He always said that.
